data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 书架上层的意外发现
data.description: 周末的图书馆里，爱瑠踩上木梯的第一级，翻开刚抽出的旧书。一片干叶从书页间滑下来，她赶紧用指尖接住，紫眼一下睁大了。
data.action: 踩着木梯第一级，从旧书页间接住滑出的干叶
data.promptProse: At the end of a quiet library aisle, Chitanda rests one foot on the first step of a low wooden ladder and keeps the other planted on the boards. She cradles the old clothbound book she has just opened and catches the dried leaf slipping between its pages, holding it by the stem. She studies its faded ochre veins with wide violet eyes. A high window throws soft afternoon light along the cable stitches in her moss-green cardigan and the brass label holders on the shelves. A full-length angle shows the open book, her hand with the leaf and her footing.
data.animaCaption: One loafer rests on the first rung of the low wooden library ladder while the other stays on the floor. Holding the old book open in her left hand, she catches the dry leaf by its stem with her right.
